title: star cocktail picks
text: star cocktail picks. So, bought these for a baby shower... they do look a little more "patriotic" in person that we had planned, but... we used them to hold some little mini sandwiches together.  They were very sturdy and held up to pressure when using.  They were about 4 1/2" long, wooden, with a little bit of the pick sticking out above the star.  The star is a bit more blue than the pic shows... the pic, to me, looks a little turquoise, which they are not.  They worked well.  I always update my reviews, answer questions and comments if new info would be be helpful.  Further, I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews... this is a review on a VERIFIED purchase, full price, independent purchase and an unbiased review.
